function.name: search_docs
function.description: Search the document corpus for relevant text chunks. Use a focused search query; rephrase it and search again if the results are insufficient. Results include document IDs that can be passed to get_document.

query.description: A search query describing the information needed.

top_k.description: Maximum number of chunks to return. If omitted, the Python function uses 3.

function.name: get_document
function.description: Retrieve a complete document by its document ID. Use this when search results do not provide enough context and the full document may contain the missing information.

document_id.description: The exact document ID, usually obtained from search_docs results.
